description: Test prompts that verify rdk-doc-finder triggers on 'where in the official docs is X' questions and routes to the correct split doc-site with a verified URL. Prompts are written the way a real RDK developer would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: tros-yolo-location
evals.prompt: YOLO 目标检测在官方文档哪里讲？给我一个权威链接。
evals.expected_output: Routes to tros_doc (ROS2 function package, not the board manual) and gives the verified boxs/detection/yolo URL.

assertions.text: Routes to tros_doc, not rdk_x_doc/rdk_s_doc, because TROS/ROS2 topics live on the TROS site.
Gives the URL https://developer.d-robotics.cc/tros_doc/boxs/detection/yolo (or clearly the boxs/detection/yolo path).

evals.name: ultra-hardware-archive-trap
evals.prompt: RDK Ultra 的硬件介绍官方文档在哪看？
evals.expected_output: Recognizes Ultra has no page under rdk_x_doc and points to the archived rdk_doc location.

assertions.text: Does NOT invent an rdk_ultra page under rdk_x_doc (rdk_x_doc only has rdk_x3 / rdk_x5).
Points to the archived rdk_doc URL https://developer.d-robotics.cc/rdk_doc/Quick_start/hardware_introduction/rdk_ultra and notes it is the legacy/migrated site.

evals.name: s100-mcu-ipc
evals.prompt: S100 的 MCU IPC 使用指南官方文档在哪个手册？
evals.expected_output: Routes to rdk_s_doc (MCU is S-only) and gives the mcu_development/mcu_ipc URL.

assertions.text: Routes to rdk_s_doc and notes MCU chapters exist only on the S site, not the X site.
Gives the URL https://developer.d-robotics.cc/rdk_s_doc/Advanced_development/mcu_development/mcu_ipc (or that exact path).

evals.name: 40pin-gpio-prefix-rule
evals.prompt: X5 的 40pin GPIO 用法官方文档的链接是什么？
evals.expected_output: Produces the 40pin GPIO URL that KEEPS the 01_ prefix, and/or advises verifying it (warns the naive strip would 404).

assertions.text: Gives the URL https://developer.d-robotics.cc/rdk_x_doc/Basic_Application/01_40pin_user_sample/gpio, keeping the 01_ prefix.
Notes (or implies) that the 01_40pin_user_sample prefix must be kept / that the derived URL should be verified, because stripping it 404s.

evals.name: studio-openclaw-doc
evals.prompt: RDK Studio 客户端里 OpenClaw 怎么用，有没有官方文档？
evals.expected_output: Routes to rdk_studio_doc and gives the user-guide/openclaw URL.

assertions.text: Routes to rdk_studio_doc (the desktop client site), not a board manual.
